'''Mint''' was an herb that could be added to [[Hot chocolate/Legends|hot chocolate]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] enjoyed it. It gave off a pleasant scent, and was used in the [[cologne]] of [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Fyg Boras]] of [[Vortex/Legends|Vortex]].
